name: Blessing of Neptune: The Pirate's Quest
source:
Get involved in the legendary tale of the blessing of the god Neptune, in which every budding pirate wishes to be the one to receive the support of the god of the seas. Playing the role of a priestess of the cult of Neptune, you will be the one with the extraordinary power to influence the fate of four adventurous pirates.

In "Blessing of Neptune: The Pirate's Quest" you will meet four fascinating young pirates with whom you will be able to form strong bonds. Each of them has their own dreams, desires and secrets just waiting to be discovered. Which pirate gets the blessing will depend entirely on you and your decisions. Therefore,be prepared for exciting conversations and difficult moral choices.  

[from [url=https://dreamverse-interactive.itch.io/blessing-of-neptune-the-pirates-quest]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
投身海神尼普顿赐福的传奇故事。每个初出茅庐的海盗，都渴望成为获得海神支持的人。你将扮演尼普顿教团的女祭司，拥有影响四位勇敢海盗命运的非凡力量。

在《Blessing of Neptune: The Pirate's Quest》中，你将结识四位迷人的年轻海盗，并与他们建立深厚的羁绊。他们各自都有梦想、渴望与秘密，等待你去发现。哪位海盗得到赐福，完全取决于你与你的决定。因此，请准备好迎接激动人心的交谈，以及艰难的道德抉择。

[摘自[url=https://dreamverse-interactive.itch.io/blessing-of-neptune-the-pirates-quest]itch.io[/url]]
